ships.name: UNIVERSAL FRIGATE
ships.description: Universal-class frigate template. The base blueprint for all specialized frigate variants, balanced core, internal, and external slot allocation ready for customization.

ships.name: ESCORT FRIGATE
ships.description: Escort-class frigate designed to protect convoys and capital ships. Heavy shields, strong weapons, and rapid response systems.

ships.name: YACHT FRIGATE
ships.description: Luxury yacht-class frigate. Opulent passenger accommodations, premium bar and pool facilities, with enough thrust to outrun trouble.

ships.name: ASSAULT FRIGATE
ships.description: Assault-class frigate built for force projection and planetary assault operations. Heavy armament, boarding facilities, and close-support ordnance.

ships.name: JUNKER FRIGATE
ships.description: Junker-class frigate, a heavily modified salvage and utility hauler. Minimal amenities, maximum cargo capacity. Gets the job done.

ships.name: SCOUT FRIGATE
ships.description: Scout-class frigate optimized for reconnaissance and deep-space exploration. Enhanced sensors, fast drives, and stealth-capable systems.

ships.name: HOPPER FRIGATE
ships.description: Hopper-class frigate designed for short-range multi-stop transit. Atmospheric-capable, high passenger and cargo capacity, ideal for system-wide logistics.

ships.name: SCIENCE FRIGATE
ships.description: Science-class frigate outfitted for field research and deep-space studies. Advanced instruments, extended life support, and dedicated laboratory modules.

ships.name: REPAIR FRIGATE
ships.description: Repair-class frigate serving as a mobile engineering platform. Construction bays, spare parts storage, and triage medical facilities allow it to sustain a fleet in the field.

ships.name: UNIVERSAL CRUISER
ships.description: Universal-class cruiser template. The baseline blueprint for all cruiser roles, substantial core and internal space with ample external hardpoints.

ships.name: FREIGHTER CRUISER
ships.description: Freighter-class cruiser, the backbone of interstellar trade. Minimal crew quarters, maximum cargo capacity, and long jump range for profitable hauls.

ships.name: DEEPSPACEEXPLORER CRUISER
ships.description: Deep Space Explorer-class cruiser built for prolonged voyages into uncharted systems. Extended life support, powerful jump drives, and comprehensive sensor suites.

ships.name: SUPERLINER CRUISER
ships.description: Superliner-class cruiser, a premier passenger vessel carrying hundreds in comfort across the stars. Luxury amenities, extensive medical facilities, and stellar entertainment.

ships.name: RESEARCH CRUISER
ships.description: Research-class cruiser equipped for extended scientific missions. State-of-the-art laboratories, environmental sampling bays, and a large crew of specialists.

ships.name: TANKER CRUISER
ships.description: Tanker-class cruiser designed to transport and distribute fuel across fleet operations. Massive fuel storage, reinforced hull, minimal weaponry.

ships.name: DESTROYER CRUISER
ships.description: Destroyer-class cruiser, a dedicated warship designed to hunt down and eliminate capital ships. Heavy ordnance, thick shields, and relentless firepower.

ships.name: MEGAYATCHT CRUISER
ships.description: Mega-yacht class cruiser, ultimate private luxury transport. Exclusive suites, a pool deck, gourmet facilities, and security staff for ultra-high-net-worth clientele.

ships.name: UNIVERSAL BATTLECRUISER
ships.description: Universal-class battleship template. The base configuration for all battleship-tier vessels, massive combined arms capability with substantial internal and external expansion.

ships.name: PIRATEFREIGHTER BATTLECRUISER
ships.description: Pirate Freighter-class battleship, a heavily-armed cargo hauler operated outside the law. Massive cargo hold with enough firepower to discourage pursuit.

ships.name: GATESHIP BATTLECRUISER
ships.description: Gate Ship-class battleship responsible for maintaining and operating interstellar gate infrastructure. Massive external hardpoints accommodate gate components and support vessels.

ships.name: GATESEC BATTLECRUISER
ships.description: Gate Security-class battleship stationed to defend critical gate installations. Heavy weapons coverage, advanced electronic warfare, and rapid interception capability.

ships.name: JUGGERNAUT BATTLECRUISER
ships.description: Juggernaut-class battleship, the heaviest conventional warship in common use. Overwhelming firepower, near-impenetrable shields, and massive troop or vehicle transport capability.

ships.name: UNIVERSAL CARRIER
ships.description: Universal-class carrier template. Massive hull with balanced hangar, internal operations, and external hardpoints, the definitive large-scale multi-role platform.

ships.name: MEGACARGO CARRIER
ships.description: Mega-Cargo carrier, the largest purpose-built freight transport in the known galaxy. Handles freight volumes that would fill an entire convoy of lesser ships.

ships.name: INDUSTRIAL CARRIER
ships.description: Industrial carrier serving as a mobile manufacturing and construction platform. Equipped with factory modules, construction bays, and raw material storage for large-scale operations.

ships.name: MEGALINER CARRIER
ships.description: Megaliner carrier, a city-in-space passenger vessel transporting thousands. Multiple decks of luxury and economy accommodations, entertainment districts, and full medical facilities.

ships.name: MISSILE CARRIER
ships.description: Missile carrier, a dedicated long-range strike platform. Enormous ordnance magazines and a comprehensive fire-control suite allow it to dominate entire battle zones from extreme range.

ships.name: HIVE CARRIER
ships.description: Hive carrier, a massive fighter and drone platform. Hundreds of small craft are launched, recovered, and resupplied through its vast external bay network.

ships.name: UNIVERSAL NOVA
ships.description: Universal Nova-class template, a superstructure of almost incomprehensible scale. Serves as the base configuration for all Nova-tier vessels.

ships.name: INTERDICTOR NOVA
ships.description: Interdictor Nova-class, designed to deny entire star systems to enemy forces. Massive interdiction arrays, overwhelming combat power, and a full complement of screening fighters.

ships.name: OBLITERATOR NOVA
ships.description: Obliterator Nova-class, a mobile superweapon platform. Virtually all internal space is sacrificed for the most devastating array of weapons ever assembled on a mobile platform.

ships.name: GENERATIONSHIP NOVA
ships.description: Generation Ship Nova-class, a vessel built not for a voyage, but for a civilization. Carries tens of thousands across centuries of travel to new star systems. A world unto itself.

ships.name: BEHEMOT NOVA
ships.description: Behemot Nova-class, a gargantuan mobile industrial platform. Processes raw materials on a planetary scale, houses entire industries, and serves as a self-sufficient roaming megastructure.
